environment: pure client synchronization domain, simulated multiple devices and network races

checks.name: Guest data is not automatically marked for cloud
Personal health preferences are excluded from wire payload
Persisted outbox retries keep the same event identity after local edits
Acknowledged self echo never overwrites an edit made while response was in flight
Clean device accepts a remote change and invalidates stale undo
Conflicting offline changes retain both choices without silent replacement
Choosing family state keeps a newer live recall visible
A concurrent local edit during fingerprinting is conservatively preserved
Remote inventory does not change allergen preferences
History undo remains correct even when backfilled before original action
Local counters and live alerts do not create redundant cloud writes
Malformed acknowledgements cannot poison revision metadata
A backwards or malformed cursor cannot replace saved progress
